title: Mesa Arch Trail
map_label: A 3D walk from the Mesa Arch trailhead to the cliff-edge arch in Canyonlands.

stops.title: Mesa Arch Trailhead
stops.alt: The short trail to Mesa Arch crossing slickrock and juniper.
stops.text: The route starts here on the Island in the Sky mesa. It is a short, easy loop to the arch.

stops.title: Mesa Arch
stops.alt: The canyon seen through the opening of Mesa Arch.
stops.text: You have reached Mesa Arch, which frames the canyon far below. It is a popular spot at sunrise.
